title: Reorder
description: A ranked list that re-sorts itself — rows glide to their new positions instead of jumping.
usage: For leaderboards, priority queues and anything whose order is the message. The FLIP technique keeps the motion honest: rows travel, they never teleport.
a11y: Rows keep their text and rank numbers after every move, so screen readers follow the final order. Autoplay pauses on hover and never starts under prefers-reduced-motion.
